Resolves #21934
Related: #21942, #21140, neomjs/pages#203

Seven existing examples can now follow the Portal’s theme with the frame a visitor actually sees on opening. Data Grid starts on its first populated rows with the 20,000 × 50 size footer. TreeGrid starts on three expanded organization levels. The other five show Animated List, Markdown VDOM, GraphScene, Breadcrumb Toolbar and Dock Perspectives and Pop-outs. The catalog sets seven availability flags. Removing their seven old recipes deletes 123 lines of capture configuration. [Fourteen original images and their predecessors](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/203).

**Merged and verified.** Pages #203 merged at 05:59:15 UTC. The Engine catalog merged at 06:00:59 UTC. The Pages deployment completed at 06:01:11 UTC, twelve seconds after the Engine merge. Subsequent public reads matched all 22 changed or already-published release images on both hosts. [Pages deployment](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/actions/runs/45121155041) · [06:00 census and post-merge receipts](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/638d89ce9fd7b22c92c9b3ac6926432feb66dc47/review-evidence/21934/examples-lock/cutoff-0600.json).

Evidence: L3 (two Portal viewport sizes, two native schemes, four emitted catalog modes and eight interactive launches) → L3 required.
